meta.task_text: Design a battery for a next-generation flagship vehicle: energy density >= 500.94 Wh/kg, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 60 degC.
meta.base_mapping_basis: task text specifies no electrode system -> default Chen2020 (anchor table rule), will be superseded by system candidates per ceiling assessment
meta.note: T_max_K threshold 333.15 = 60 degC; 4C charge evaluated at 45 degC ambient (4C_charge_45C protocol) so 15 K rise budget; stage1 elimination lines use protocol defaults (max_energy_ev 0.0, max_homo_ev -6.0); all five degree-of-freedom categories take widest interpretation (task text declares no locks).

objective_breakdown: 3 gates: (1) ED >= 500.94 Wh/kg (binding; far beyond conventional Li-ion -> material-level jump mandatory), (2) 4C charge plated=false (anode potential >= 0 V), (3) T_max <= 333.15 K at 45 degC ambient (15 K rise budget). Trade-off: thick electrodes raise ED but worsen heat dissipation and plating margin; resolve via electrolyte transport + cooling rather than sacrificing ED.
candidate_strategy: R1 Chen2020 baseline (1C + calc-energy + 4C safety) + ceiling assessment of existing-system architecture space (expected ~350-450 Wh/kg -> gap confirmed -> escalate to Stage 2). R2 materials: system candidates LNMO high-voltage 4.7V (--base LNMO.json) and OKane2022 NMC811/graphite+SiOx; electrolyte formulation transport overrides (high sigma / t+); molecular additive funnel (FEC/VC/LiFSI-class) if budget allows. R3+ combined best system x architecture (thin collectors/separator, thick active, low porosity) x electrolyte x cooling h; iterate with log-evaluate until all 3 gates pass or three-strike.
budget_allocation: R1 baseline (3 sim + 1 eval); R2 ceiling variant + funnel (2-4 sim + funnel + eval); R3 LNMO full sim + eval; R4 OKane2022 full sim + eval; R5 best combined + eval; R6+ refinement per diagnosis (max ~3 more rounds).
risk_and_fallback: R1 ED likely ~150-250 Wh/kg, ceiling ~350-450: if architecture space exhausted (3 strikes same cause ED gap) question system boundary (electrode composition route; Li-metal approximation unavailable -> honest note) then close negative or direction change, never relax thresholds. T_max fail -> Stage 3 scale fix (cooling h/thickness). Plating fail -> electrolyte sigma/t+ bridge (Stage 2) or negative thickness/particle radius (Stage 3). Verify ED ceiling first, then safety gates.

Molecular additives (FEC/VC/PES/DTD) screened in funnel for SEI/plating suppression; additives affect aging/SEI not direct ED. Params listed before run.

detail: All 4 additive candidates pass elimination lines (mace/chgnet converged, energy_ev << 0; xtb homo_ev <= -11.9 eV < -6.0). candidates.name: LNMO-R2

llm_reason: Round 4: ED gate passed (LNMO-R1 520.2, OKane2022-C1 514.5) but 4C plating persists (DFN anode min -0.139 V). Diagnosis: the dip occurs during the 4C charge step at 175 A/m2 (nominal-4.5Ah x 4C), i.e., charge overpotential at the negative, not end-of-discharge (anode +1.93 V there). Countermeasures target all overpotential components: solid diffusion (smaller negative particles), electrolyte concentration polarization (higher t+ and sigma), N/P margin (thicker negative). Transport values are domain estimates for LiFSI-class high-transport electrolyte (marked estimate).

reason: Rounds 1-4 results: baseline ED 400.3 -> ceiling (idealized NMC811/graphite) 487.3 < 500.94 -> material escalation confirmed; LNMO 4.7V system passes ED (520.2 Wh/kg) and T_max (<=324.3 K) gates; binding constraint is now 4C plating (anode min -0.14 V DFN). Direction: ED strategy locked (LNMO + mass-cut architecture + HiTrans electrolyte); remaining budget spent on plating countermeasures (particle size, transport, N/P) at Stage 3/2 boundary.
candidate_strategy: LNMO-R2 (round 5): negative particles 2 um, t+ 0.6, sigma 3.0 S/m, D 2.5e-10, negative 115 um. If plating persists: escalate transport further (negative porosity up, D up, sigma up, particles down) at Stage 3; if transport ceiling reached (sigma/t+/D at physical limits), question boundary at three-strike and consider negative exchange-current density lever (electrode modification, estimate-marked) or honest negative close on the plating gate.
budget_allocation: R5 LNMO-R2 full sim; R6 plating-hardening variant; R7 (if needed) kinetic lever or close; closing: DFN 1C precision run for final candidate, endorse skip, render, deliverables.
risk_and_fallback: Plating = electrolyte-transport + solid-diffusion scale issue; ED margin is +19 Wh/kg (520.2 vs 500.94) giving ~1 g mass headroom for N/P or porosity countermeasures. T_max has 9 K margin. Overcharge/nail abuse scenarios not in task text -> not required.
